text: Final categorization: POSSIBLE (Justification: The paper is a non-review research article that includes a land use prediction component using the CA-Markov model to project irrigated cropland in 2030 for five Central Asian countries. However, LULC prediction is not the primary focus—it serves as an input to assess future irrigation water requirements (IWR) under climate scenarios. The study does implement two future scenarios (RCP2.6 and RCP4.5) and reports quantitative land use changes (e.g., cropland area changes, Kappa accuracy index of 0.84), but its central objective is IWR estimation, not LULC modeling. While national-scale spatial implementation is present for each of the five countries, LULC prediction is auxiliary to the main goal of evaluating water demand under CO₂ fertilization and climate change.)
